text: All staff accounts are granted only the minimum privileges needed for their job role, and multi-factor authentication is required for every remote login.
System owners must review user access lists every quarter and promptly remove permissions from employees who change roles or leave the company.
Company laptops and database volumes are encrypted at rest with full disk encryption, and all encryption keys are stored in a managed key vault.
All internal and customer traffic must travel over TLS 1.2 or higher, and unencrypted protocols such as plain FTP and HTTP are banned on the network.
Authentication failures, privilege changes, and administrative actions are logged centrally and retained for at least twelve months for audit purposes.
Security monitoring alerts are reviewed by the operations team every business day, and unanswered critical alerts escalate to the on-call engineer.
Any suspected data breach must be reported to the security team within one hour, and the incident response plan assigns a single incident commander.
After a security incident is contained, affected customers and regulators must be notified within seventy-two hours according to our breach procedure.
Production databases are backed up nightly with thirty days of retention, and restores are tested each quarter to confirm our disaster recovery objectives.
Backup copies are stored in a separate geographic region so critical services can be rebuilt if the primary data center is lost in a disaster.
Before signing, every third-party vendor with access to company data completes a security assessment, and contracts require an annual reassessment.
Our payment provider must encrypt our data inside their platform, but our main concern is finishing the vendor security review before the contract renews.
All production changes go through peer review and an approved change ticket, and emergency fixes must be documented within one business day of deployment.
Developers run static security checks in the pipeline and record each release in the change log so monitoring can correlate deploy times with alerts.
All new employees complete security awareness training within their first two weeks, and returning staff repeat the course once every year.
Staff who fail the annual phishing quiz must retake the training, and their system access is suspended until the refresher module has been passed.
The office is closed on public holidays, and employees should record planned leave in the HR system at least two weeks in advance of their time off.
Our mission is to help small businesses grow by making dependable software that people enjoy using every single day of the working week.
